class.name: GodotDoctorEditorValidationReporter
class.brief_description: Validation reporter for the Godot Editor. Displays results as toasts and pushes them to the [GodotDoctorDock].

method.name: _init
method.description: Initializes this reporter and adds the [GodotDoctorDock] to the editor layout at the position defined by [member GodotDoctorSettings.default_dock_position].

method.name: on_started_run_for_edited_scene_root
method.description: Called when a validation run starts for [param scene_root]. Clears the dock and sets the active scene root for validation display.

method.name: on_finished_run_for_edited_scene_root
method.description: Called when a validation run finishes for [param _scene_root].

method.name: on_started_run_for_edited_resource
method.description: Called when a validation run starts for the edited resource.

method.name: on_finished_run_for_edited_resource
method.description: Called when a validation run finishes for the edited resource.

method.name: on_run_for_edited_scene_root_requested
method.description: Called when a validation run is requested for the edited scene root.

method.name: report_on_scene_validation_collection
method.description: Reports validation results from [param scene_validation_collection] to the dock.

method.name: report_on_resource_validation_collection
method.description: Reports validation results from [param resource_validation_collection] to the dock.

method.name: report_node_messages
method.description: Pushes a toast notification and adds each message in [param messages] to the dock as a node warning associated with [param node].

method.name: report_resource_messages
method.description: Pushes a toast notification and adds each message in [param messages] to the dock as a resource warning associated with [param resource].

method.name: promoted_severity_level
method.description: Promotes [param severity_level] to [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.ERROR] if [param treat_warnings_as_errors] is [code]true[/code] and the severity is [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.WARNING]. Returns the (possibly promoted) severity level as an [int].

members.member: The [GodotDoctorDock] that validation messages are pushed to.

constants.constant: Path to the dock scene instantiated by this reporter.
